summary: Enclosed tower on Garrett Mountain, Lake County, CA. A June 1944 newspaper item is the earliest mention found; the county index lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source we read describes what remains on the mountain.

events.note: Garrett Mt. Lookout Station is named in a June 1944 Ukiah Republican Press item, reprinted by Forest Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Record (kind enclosed_tower, status gone, coordinates) matches the FFLOS county table row; no change proposed. Only two pages were usable: a 1944 newspaper clipping and the county index. No build date, staffing record, access or current-site description was found, so facts.access is omitted and the story says no source describes the site. Peakbagging.com's 2023 California table (http://peakbagging.com/Peak%20Lists/CA_Lookout2.html) lists 'Garrett Mountain' without the '(LO site)' suffix it uses for removed buildings; its status column could not be read from the flattened text, so it was not used and the gone status was not changed. Map sites mention a 'Garrett Mountain Lookout Road' that was not read. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 5 page reads.
